# Contributor onboarding

1. Confirm which repository, contributor role, and development environment the guide covers.
2. Verify prerequisites and commands against the owning README, setup guide, workspace scripts, and current tooling. Never copy secrets or local environment values.
3. Order the steps as access, prerequisites, checkout/materialization, setup, validation, and help/escalation. Mark optional steps and platform differences.
4. Link authoritative instructions instead of duplicating them. Use document-organization for placement and metadata.
5. Check every command for safe repetition. Do not silently switch branches, advance unrelated repositories, or overwrite user state.
